text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (April 4, 2025) for 12 Aldergrove Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (April 4, 2025) for 12 Aldergrove Avenue, Folder No. 24 221528 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so grant an extension of time to December 31, 2025.
